Implementation Plan Plan for #8291 child `p3b-stall-breaker` (stall-breaker phase P3b): poller failure-signature breaker; stall exhaustion no longer closes issues **Planning ref:** `orchestrator/project-8291` @ `55ed087113b52148e926732d7fc4ca0a2e0e7388`. The integration branch mismatch line reads `false`. **Source design:** `docs/plans/remove-unattended-pipeline-stuck-states-plan.md`, section "P3 — Failure-signature breaker", steps 2–4, plus goal G3. This issue delivers the poller half: the breaker and the exhaustion change. The failure handlers in `plan.yml` and `clarify.yml` that emit `AI_FAILURE_FINGERPRINT_V1` markers (P3 step 1) belong to sibling issue P3a and are not touched here. ## Automation wiring (§20.E) - **Kind of change:** extends existing scripts only. No new script, no supervisor. - **Entry point:** `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` (poller cron) runs `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`, which calls `run_standalone_stall_recovery` (standalone issues) and the managed per-project stall block that calls `check-stalls` and `recover_stalled_issue`. - **Long-running supervisor (§20.C):** none needed. The work rides the existing poller tick. - **DB work (§20.D):** none. - **`docs/scripts-pending-removal.md` (§20.F):** no entry, because no new script is added. ## Files likely to change - `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` - `scripts/orchestrate_lib.py` - `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` - `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py` - `tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py` - `README.md` - `changelog.d/stuck-states-p3b-stall-breaker.md` (new) - `agents.d/stuck-states-p3b-stall-breaker.md` (new) ## Functions or modules to implement **1. `scripts/orchestrate_lib.py`: pure evaluator plus a CLI subcommand** - Add constants: - `FAILURE_FINGERPRINT_MARKER_RE`, which matches exactly ``, where: - `p` matches `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$` - `fp` matches `^[0-9a-f]{12}$` - `id` matches `^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$` - `FAILURE_FINGERPRINT_BREAKER_MARKER = "AI_FAILURE_FINGERPRINT_BREAKER_V1"` - `FAILURE_FINGERPRINT_PHASE_LABELS = {"plan": "ai:plan-failed", "clarify": "ai:clarify-failed"}`. Any other phase maps to `ai:needs-human`. - Add `evaluate_failure_fingerprint_breaker(comments, trusted_login, repeat_max, comments_complete) -> dict`. It does no I/O. - **Trusted comments:** keep only comments whose `user.login` equals `trusted_login` exactly, with a positive integer `id`. An empty `trusted_login` returns `{"decision": "identity_unavailable"}`. - **Order:** sort by `(created_at, id)`. - **Consumption point:** the newest trusted comment that contains `` - a short history table built from `FFB_RECENT_JSON` (phase, fp, run link) - a line saying the unblock judge will pick this up. - It logs `STALL_FINGERPRINT_BREAKER issue= scope= outcome=tripped phase=

That way the breaker fires on the tick after the second failure even when the issue just flipped back to `ai:clarification`. - Pass `cache_available` as `complete` when `_standalone_staged_support_cache_available=complete`, and `true` when it is `true`. - On `trip`: call apply, write the state (with `failure_fingerprints = recent`), then `continue`. - On `identity_unavailable`, `history_unavailable` or `unavailable`: log `STALL_FINGERPRINT_BREAKER ... outcome=` and fall through to the legacy path. - On `none`: fall through as today. e. **Standalone state** (`_extract_standalone_state_json_from_comments` projection, about line 17833): - Add `failure_fingerprints: (if (.failure_fingerprints|type)=="array" then .failure_fingerprints[-5:] else [] end)`. - Add the same key to the three default-object literals (lines ~17817/17824/17829/17844). - The phase-change reset (about line 22776) must not touch this key. - The key is for observation only; the comment history is the authoritative input. f. **Standalone `skip)` arm** (about lines 23731–23750), when `STALL_FINGERPRINT_BREAKER_ENABLED=true`: - Do not call `close_linked_pr`, do not add `ai:closed`, do not call `gh issue close`. - Instead: `ensure_label_exists "ai:needs-human"`, add the label, and check it by reading labels again. - If the label is present: - Post one comment with the recovery history: phase, the exhausted counter and which counter tripped (`stall_recovery_count` or `phase_attempts`), the limit, minutes stuck, and the last ≤5 entries of `failure_fingerprints` from state. - Log `STALL_EXHAUSTED_ESCALATED issue= scope=standalone phase=

attempts= limit= outcome=labelled`. - Keep `tg_notify_issue` with the existing `CRITICAL` level, reworded to "left open with ai:needs-human for the unblock judge". - If the label is missing: log `outcome=label_failed`, post no comment, and set `took_action="false"` so the state is not touched and the next tick tries again. - Keep `STALL_RECOVERY_SHOULD_INCREMENT="false"`. - When the switch is `false`, the current close code runs unchanged in the `else` branch. g. **Managed loop**, new function `run_managed_failure_fingerprint_breaker`, called right before `_stall_check_args` is built (about line 30378) and inside the same `INVOKE_JUDGE_FOR_STUCK != true` block: - Iterate over the current wave's issues in `${STATE_FILE}` that have a `github_issue` and a status outside `merged|closed|skipped|not_created`. - Read labels from `LABELS_JSON` and skip issues whose `determine_phase` is in `TERMINAL_PHASES`, in `DEDICATED_HANDLER_PHASES`, or that carry a latch label. - Read comments from `_current_wave_details_json[].comments` when `comments_available == true`. - Run `_failure_fingerprint_breaker_check`. - On `trip`: run apply, patch `LABELS_JSON` for that issue so `check-stalls` sees the new label on this tick, write `failure_fingerprints` into the wave issue entry with `jq` into `${STATE_FILE}.tmp` and then `mv` (the existing pattern), and set `STALL_STATE_CHANGED=t
